historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (23.73%) diverges from Revenue CAGR (14.52%) by 63.4%. This divergence driven by massive AI capex depressing FCF temporarily. Using Revenue CAGR as primary rate given it's more representative of sustainable business growth. Equity growth accelerated due to strong earnings growth (18.82% EPS CAGR) while FCF suppressed by $64.5B capex in FY2025.

base.notes: Revenue CAGR starting at 15%, decelerating as AI growth normalizes. FCF margin based on FY2025 actual (25.4%). Assumes capex moderates from $64.5B toward sustainable levels by Year 5.

bull.notes: AI monetization accelerates with Copilot adoption expanding from 3.3% to 30%+ of M365 users. Azure capacity constraints resolved sooner, capturing pent-up demand. $625B backlog converts strongly. FCF margin expands as capex growth slows while revenue accelerates.

bear.notes: Copilot adoption stalls, AI ROI questioned. Capacity constraints cause share loss to AWS/Google. Massive capex ($71B+) continues without commensurate revenue growth. Regulatory pressures force pricing changes. FCF margin compressed by sustained high capex and margin pressure from AI costs.

probability_weighted.calculation: Bull case reflects AI upside, but current $415 price suggests market pricing in scenarios beyond our bull case. Base case most likely given revenue trajectory and capacity constraints. Bear case significant if capex ROI disappoints.

notes: Microsoft trading at $415 (Feb 2026) implies market expects sustained 18-20%+ growth with margin expansion beyond our bull case assumptions.
Key value driver: AI monetization success. Copilot expansion from 3.3% to 20%+ penetration would justify higher valuation.
Capacity constraints through June 2026 create near-term growth ceiling but strong $625B backlog provides medium-term visibility.
Capex-to-revenue ratio at 22.9% in FY2025, expected to stay elevated. FCF growth will lag revenue growth until capex moderates.
At current price, requires 15%+ CAGR to terminal value, achievable only in optimistic scenarios. Premium valuation assumes flawless AI execution.
Entry price analysis: To achieve 15% CAGR, would need to enter at $118-208 range depending on scenario. Current $415 offers minimal margin of safety.
Regulatory risks not fully priced in - FTC/EU investigations could force structural changes to high-margin cloud business.
Strong competitive position and execution track record support premium, but valuation leaves little room for disappointment.
